page.overview:
Who is Stella?

Stella is a character from Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo's Dungeon. She is Shirma's aunt, who raises the young White Mage as her own daughter.

Stella most likely used to live in the town that would later be known as Lostime and grew up with a sister, Elena, a White Mage. Through her sister's eventual marriage to Nero, a Black Mage, Stella became an aunt to her nieces Shirma and Croma. Stella came to respect Nero particularly well, and most likely visited Shirma's home in the suburbs. She would later set up a farm farther away from Lostime. Stella became good friends with Dardola, the owner of Dardola's dining, a cafe in Lostime. They would often go fishing together and Dardola made use of Stella's special biscuits as a unique dish for his cafe.

When a monster that fed on fear, despair, and suffering called the Destroyer attacked the town that would later be known as Lostime, Mayor Gale deemed they must sever their emotions. Stella argued that emotions were what made them all human, including fear, but Gale did not listen and gathered the Oracles to release the Guardian Beasts from the crystals who sealed the Destroyer away alongside everyone's memories and Memoria from the rest of the world. Stella's sister and brother-in-law were killed in the battle and Croma disappeared and would not be seen for a long time.

The Bell of Oblivion was created during the sealing of the Destroyer. Under its influence, everyone in the town kept losing their memories, including Shirma. Stella became exasperated at everyone preaching about the so-called beauty of "forgetting". After Shirma did not recognize her mother in a photograph at her old house, Stella took her to live at her farm in the outskirts of town to save her from the memory erasion. Stella raised Shirma like her own child and also comforted Meja, who was lost after her parents were killed in the battle with the Destroyer.
